answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing, so renewal or negotiation cannot meet the mandated 18% reduction. The contract expires in 14 days and cannot lapse without delivery exposure. The low-cost vendor is the only documented option that meets the savings mandate, with prior evidence of rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing. However, that evidence does not establish capacity, quality, or on-time delivery performance at Halden's current 94% line utilization; those downstream delivery risks must be explicitly gated before award.
